title: fr.audio_out.play arguments
description: Plays PCM the hub serves at GET /v1/audio/out/<play_id> (design D3). Dispatch never blocks: OK once the fr_stream task has the play, INVALID_ARGS for a rate the driver does not take. A GET that fails ends it with play_done net_lost (samples 0).

play_id.description: issued by the hub; the GET path names it

sample_hz.description: the PCM's rate, one of the config's rates (Hz; 8000..48000)
